description: Component that sends SMS or WhatsApp notifications when Dagster assets

account_sid_env_var.label: Account Sid Env Var
account_sid_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the Twilio Account SID (e.g., TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID).

auth_token_env_var.label: Auth Token Env Var
auth_token_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the Twilio Auth Token (e.g., TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN).

from_number.label: From Number
from_number.description: The Twilio phone number to send from (e.g., '+15551234567'). For WhatsApp use the plain E.164 number — the 'whatsapp:' prefix is added automatically when channel='whatsapp'.

to_numbers.label: To Numbers
to_numbers.description: List of recipient phone numbers in E.164 format (e.g., '+15559876543').

channel.label: Channel
channel.description: Messaging channel to use. 'sms' sends a standard SMS; 'whatsapp' prefixes both from/to numbers with 'whatsapp:' automatically.

message_template.label: Message Template
message_template.description: Template string for the notification message. Available format variables: {asset_key}, {event_type}, {timestamp}, {run_id}.

monitored_assets.label: Monitored Assets
monitored_assets.description: List of asset key strings to watch (e.g., ['my_asset', 'namespace/other']). When None (default) all asset events are monitored.

on_failure.label: On Failure
on_failure.description: Send a notification when an asset materialization fails.

on_success.label: On Success
on_success.description: Send a notification when an asset materialization succeeds.

minimum_interval_seconds.label: Minimum Interval Seconds
minimum_interval_seconds.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between sensor evaluations.

name: Twilio Notification Sensor
